build_grpcio_package: build the grpcio Python package using python setup.py with Cython extensions and BoringSSL
check_linker_need_libatomic: check if the system linker requires the libatomic library for C++ atomic operations
cython_extensions_and_necessity: configure Cython extension modules for grpc._cython.cygrpc and determine if Cython is needed
build_grpc_with_system_deps: build grpcio using system installations of OpenSSL, zlib, c-ares, and re2 via environment variables
clean_grpcio_build: clean the grpcio build artifacts using python setup.py clean command
